description: This file defines a class 'Select' that extends Drupal's core database select query class to implement PostgreSQL-specific query behaviors, including ordering and expression handling.

classes.name: Select
classes.description: PostgreSQL-specific implementation of the Drupal database select query, extending core functionality with custom ordering and expression methods.

methods.name: orderRandom
methods.description: Adds an ORDER BY clause to randomize query results using PostgreSQL's RANDOM() function.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Overrides the default orderBy method to handle PostgreSQL-specific ordering, including NULLS FIRST/LAST and automatic field addition for ordered fields.

methods.name: addExpression
methods.description: Adds a SQL expression with an alias to the select query, ensuring unique alias names.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the query with savepoint management, handling exceptions and releasing savepoints appropriately.
